name: Sir Arthur Doorman IV
source: Arthur Doorman the Fourth is a hereditary wizard from one of the oldest magical families in the world. He took the headmaster position in Cordale at the age of 42 and made the Academy one of the best in the world. Like his ancestors, he is noble and responsible in his job of guiding young wizards on the path of virtue.
